units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:6:4">Y. Succ. V, 55ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>צ׳ של מקדש וכ׳</he> the cymbal of the Temple originated from Moses’ days. Ib. 55ᵇ bot. <he>מיריחו … הצי׳</he> in Jericho they could hear the sound of the cymbal (of the Temple).

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:1">Shek. V, 1</cite> <he>בן ארזא על הצ׳</he> (the family of) Ben Arza had charge of the cymbal. Y. ib. 48ᵈ bot. <he>הניף … והקיש בן א׳ בצ׳</he> when the Sagan waved the flag, B. A. struck the cymbal; <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 7:3">Tam. VII, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 2:5">Arakh. II, 5</cite> <he>והצ׳ לבד</he> only a single cymbal was used in the Temple; a. e.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 75a:7">B. Bath. 75ᵃ</cite>, contrad. to <he>סוכה</he> (Rashb. <cite ref="R00475"><he>צֵל</he></cite>); (correct vers. in) <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 361">Yalk. Is. 361</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. B. Bath. l. c. note 9).
